name: Brizy
summary: Drag-and-drop website builder with an AI builder, hosted on Brizy Cloud or as a WordPress plugin, with multi-site agency plans and a white-label version for resellers.
best_for: freelancers and agencies that build several client websites and want hosting included, with a white-label option to resell the builder under their own brand
skip_if: you need one simple site at the lowest price, you want full code-level design control, or you mainly sell products online
honest_knock: Personal covers one website and each extra site costs $17 a month. E-commerce sites are priced separately under Brizy Shops, and the WordPress plugin has its own pricing, so the Cloud prices are not the whole picture. We have not used Brizy ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Personal (Cloud) · billed monthly, 1 website, hosting included
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 in a browser render of brizy.io/pricing-cloud, USD, both billing toggles; taxes not included) Brizy Cloud is the hosted version. Personal is $19 a month or $190 a year for 1 website, with each additional site at $17 a month, 1 workspace and unlimited team members. Agency is $69 a month or $690 a year for 10 websites, additional sites $12 a month, 10 workspaces and priority email support. White Label is $159 a month or $1,590 a year for 10 websites, additional sites $8 a month, client management, the builder under your own brand and client billing through Stripe. Enterprise is quoted and adds on-premises hosting, API and SSO access and tiered volume pricing. All Cloud plans include the AI builder and hosting on AWS with unlimited visits and storage, and there is a 14-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee. E-commerce sites are priced separately under Brizy Shops, and the WordPress plugin has its own pricing; neither was read.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: E-commerce sites are priced separately under Brizy Shops, and the WordPress plugin has its own pricing; neither was read.

compare_with.why: Webflow is in our dossiers too and gives designers deeper control over layout, CMS and code; Brizy is the simpler drag-and-drop builder with hosting included and a cheaper route to white-labelling for agencies
